purpose: A0 (Pre-A1)–B2 үйлдэлд суурилсан Монгол→Чех сургалтын суурь стандарт

architecture.rule: mission ≠ learning session ≠ micro_skill. One session targets a small coherent group of skills; content and audio cannot be inferred from title alone.
architecture.source_of_truth: Approved versioned repo JSON only; Drive is editorial input/export and never silently overrides published source.

content_selection.lexical_family_vs_surface_form: Distinct lemma/sense/POS/inflection fields; Czech senses are tied to learner scenario. Do not treat plural, case and homographs as unrelated duplicated audio without reason.
content_selection.topic_reuse_rule: Prefer previously reviewed vocabulary; track prerequisites explicitly. Do not insert unseen terms into comprehension/transfer without scaffolding.
content_selection.source_license_rule: Record attribution and license on imported material; independently AI-authored content must not be falsely attributed to dictionaries.
content_selection.register_rule: ty/vy, respectful requests, feminine/masculine/plural/case forms reviewed by scenario; never blindly generate forms.
content_selection.safety_rule: Distinguish Pozor!/Stůj!/Stůjte!/Zastavte stroj! with actual workplace context. TTS and STT cannot certify safety competence.

steps.description_mn: Бодит хэрэгцээ ба дүрийг 1 зураг/сонсголын сценээр тайлбарлах
steps.contract: Scene context is comprehended; no new Czech without context

steps.description_mn: Зорилтот богино харилцааг нэг удаа сонсгох
steps.contract: Each utterance separately playable; transcript optionally hidden

steps.description_mn: Хэлсэн санааг эх хэлний тайлбаргүйгээр зураг/үйлдэлтэй холбох
steps.contract: Distractors are semantically plausible, not trick errors

steps.description_mn: Авианы бүтэн утгатай хэсгийг сонсож дуурайх
steps.contract: Chunk audio has its own unique utterance_id; no syllable chopping

steps.description_mn: Үгийн гол цөм, утга ба хувирлын зохистой жишээг таних
steps.contract: No lexeme vs inflected form conflation
Can repeat chunks; STT transcription is not phonetic grading

steps.description_mn: Нөхцөлд хэрэглэж буй 1–2 загварыг харьцуулан ойлгох
steps.contract: Explain only grammar needed for task

steps.description_mn: Нэг утгатай хэсгийг сольж шинэ өгүүлбэр зохиох
Аудио/орчуулгагүй үед тохирох Чех хэллэгийг санаад хэлэх
steps.contract: Hints recorded; hints reduce independent score

steps.description_mn: Бичвэргүй шинэ бичлэгээс зорилтот санаа таних
steps.contract: New voice/context; no source audio reuse as test

steps.description_mn: Хоёр талт ярианд дүр хариуцан оролцох
Төлөвлөөгүй энгийн асуултад бие дааж хариулах
steps.contract: A0 can be one phrase; scale length with proficiency

steps.description_mn: Урьд үзүүлээгүй байрлал/хүн/мэдээлэлтэй нөхцөлд ижил чадвар хэрэглэх
steps.contract: Do not leak exact test stimulus in practice

steps.description_mn: Бодит үр дүнд суурилж даалгавар гүйцэтгэл, зохистой хэллэг, ойлгомж, засварлах чадварыг үнэлэх
steps.contract: No hidden auto-pass; fail triggers targeted re-practice

requirements: Czech native audio or expert-vetted voice
hearing contrasts and intelligibility assessed distinctly
reading comprehension separated from reading aloud
current stuck word only speaker playback
guided next word only after acceptable pronunciation recognition or accessible assisted progression
retention measured by delayed novel task

lesson_cycle.flexible_timing: Steps may be short/merged in visible UI but all 15 pedagogical functions need evidence; tasks beyond time limit may span sessions.

feedback_loop.feedback_mn_tone: Тодорхой бөгөөд шууд засах; алдааны шалтгаан ба зөв жишээг гаргах
feedback_loop.never: Do not fabricate confidence or label phonetic correctness from transcript match alone
feedback_loop.assistance_limits: 3 unsuccessful repetitions trigger explanation and optional assisted transition rather than infinite block.

reader_stt_contract.progression: advance only when current word is reasonably recognized within context; otherwise highlight current word
reader_stt_contract.retry: on repeated low confidence, show model word and offer retry; do not falsely mark mastered
reader_stt_contract.assessment_prohibition: STT transcript alone does not establish Czech phonetic quality or CEFR ability

retrieval.due_days_are: Pedagogical starting heuristic, not validated individualized optimal intervals

algorithm_rules.independent_correct: advance to next review interval only if task transfer also succeeded
algorithm_rules.correct_with_hint: retain or shorten interval; not mastery
algorithm_rules.incorrect: same-day corrective micro-practice then next-day review

retrieval.vocabulary_frequency: Track lemma+sense per context; repeated surface forms may be intentional spaced review, not new acquisitions.
retrieval.reporting: Retention metrics compare first encounter vs delayed unassisted response; no promised 10× speed claims.

assessment.mission_exit_provisional_passing_rule: total >= 6 of 8, task_success >= 1, appropriacy >= 1, no critical safety error; threshold remains calibration hypothesis not CEFR certification
assessment.mission_gate: Need at least two independent novel scenarios for high-stakes mission exit; delayed transfer follow-up; no auto-pass based on listening alone.
assessment.cefr_gateway: Independent integrated calibrated tasks for listening, reading, spoken interaction, spoken production and writing as appropriate to band; CEFR band achievement never inferred from mission count.
assessment.safety_critical_failure: Wrong dangerous stop/continue direction overrides numeric rubric; do not simulate real hazard exposure.
assessment.stt_policy: transcription helps compare intended semantics, not direct pronunciation score

stories.primary_goal: Graded suspenseful storyline from known words but meaningful adult situations.
stories.character_continuity: Stable cast, goals, consequences; each installment reveals new information without random word inventory.
stories.language_budget: At least 90% of running-word tokens previously introduced or explicitly scaffolded is an initial editorial target, NOT proof of readability.
stories.level_progression: A0 visual mini-scenes → A1 linked short scenes → A2 connected episodes → B1 multi-scene story → B2 multiple perspectives
stories.testing: Story comprehension, guided aloud reading and open-ended response are distinct; no forced phonetic score.

audio_factory.trigger: Only if versioned content is CZ/MN editorial approved and utterance manifest validated

asset_contract.unit: One utterance per audio file; words, sentences, dialogue turns, narrative paragraphs stored separately.

audio_factory.duplication_policy: Reuse audio only when canonical text, voice, register, tempo/context and type match; different forms/meanings remain separate IDs.
audio_factory.no_batch_concat: Do not pass words+sentences+stories to TTS as one unlabeled text blob; an explicit manifest maps each ID to one asset.
audio_factory.storage: Versioned immutable audio files and manifest; persistent object storage. No playback-time generation dependency for released lessons.

automated_qa.permitted_ci_pass: Automated structural validations are PASS only for what they actually execute; do not set native language editor approved=true from static CI.
automated_qa.current_status: System design only; no actual content/audio certifiable.
